task.description:
WF-02 Step 03 (TEST-DESIGNER) for PW-13 Batch 1: RND-UI-01, RND-UI-02, RND-UI-03, RND-UI-04.

Branch: feature/WF02-pw13-rnd-ui-20260813. Verify with git branch --show-current.

Design and write test specifications and test files for all 4 MUST requirements:

**RND-UI-01 — Six-state renderer union and single error classifier:**
- Unit tests in `web/tests/unit/classifyError.test.ts`:
  * 401 → permission-denied
  * 403 → permission-denied  
  * 409 → stale-version
  * 429 with Retry-After → rate-limit
  * 429 without Retry-After → fetch-failure
  * 5xx → fetch-failure
  * Network error (no status) → fetch-failure
- Component tests in `web/tests/unit/QueryStateBoundary.test.tsx`:
  * never arm is unreachable (TypeScript check via @ts-expect-error)
  * Each state renders the correct sub-component

**RND-UI-02 — Loading state with skeleton layout:**
- Component tests in `web/tests/unit/SkeletonLayout.test.tsx`:
  * aria-busy='true' is present unconditionally
  * Renders 5 skeleton rows by default
  * Custom rowCount is respected
  * Column widths match widthPercent values

**RND-UI-03 — Fetch failure state with explicit retry:**
- Component tests in `web/tests/unit/FetchError.test.tsx`:
  * role='alert' is present
  * onRetry is called when Retry button is clicked
  * Component renders without crashing

**RND-UI-04 — Leak-free permission denied surface:**
- Component tests in `web/tests/unit/PermissionDenied.test.tsx`:
  * Fixed copy text is present exactly
  * Task Inbox link present
  * No HTTP status numbers in rendered text
  * No UUID-shaped strings in rendered text
  * No numbers matching /40[13]/ in rendered text

Write the actual test files to web/tests/unit/. Read the implemented components first to write accurate tests.

Commit: git add web/tests/ && git commit -m 'test(frontend): RND-UI-01..04 unit tests — classifyError, QueryStateBoundary, SkeletonLayout, FetchError, PermissionDenied'
git push origin feature/WF02-pw13-rnd-ui-20260813
acceptance_criteria: web/tests/unit/classifyError.test.ts covers all 7 HTTP status mappings
web/tests/unit/SkeletonLayout.test.tsx covers aria-busy, rowCount, column widths
web/tests/unit/FetchError.test.tsx covers role=alert and onRetry callback
web/tests/unit/PermissionDenied.test.tsx covers fixed copy, no data leakage
Every MUST acceptance criterion from RND-UI-01..04 has at least one test
